text:
Alex: quick heads-up — we saw ~2k pod disconnects in us-east1-gpulane between 03:10-03:25 UTC, app-level retries masking failures. I think conntrack/NAT exhaustion.
Priya: any logs/alerts? which nodes?
Alex: alert from monitoring: conntrack_table_utilization > 94% on gpupool-us-east1a. snippet:
```
ALERT conntrack_table_exhaustion - gpupool-us-east1a - 94.2%
netstat -s | grep conntrack
# conntrack count: 65534
```
Pods saw a bunch of `ECONNRESET` to model-cache service (same AZ).
Jenna: we rolled a kernel MTU tweak last week for RDMA farm — could be fragmentation causing new flows per chunk. RDMA interfaces still 9000, infra veths 1500, saw more retransmits.
Marco: also check ephemeral port usage. If many short-lived outbound connections to the same destination + SNAT per flow, conntrack fills fast. run on node:
```
ss -s
cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range
```
Sam: ops-bot flagged the alert and autoscaler couldn't add NAT nodes fast enough. Quick mitigations: reduce tcp timeout for established conns, increase nf_conntrack_max, and temporarily scale NAT gateway cluster.
ops-bot: [ALERT] conntrack_table_usage=94.2% (threshold 90%) — affected: gpupool-us-east1a, gpupool-us-east1b
Priya: can app reuse connections to model-cache? We now open new upstream sockets per request. Connection pooling would cut entry churn massively.
Alex: app team said pooling requires infra work, not immediate. Need infra short-term changes.
Jenna: sysctl we can change via daemonset:
```
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=300
net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range='20000 60999'
```
Also enable conntrack garbage collection tuning and lower tcp_fin_timeout.
Marco: long-term: consider node-level SNAT (assign secondary IPs) or eBPF-based SNAT (Cilium maglev) to avoid central NAT bottleneck. Both have cost/ops tradeoffs.
Sam: cost note — doubling NAT nodes is ~0.6x monthly GPU infra delta but much cheaper than retry chaos. Recommend scaling NAT pool during peak and rolling sysctl change.
Priya: create runbook item, add postmortem checklist: telemetry to correlate conntrack entries -> pod IP -> dest, and add alert for ephemeral port high-water.
Alex: action items:
- infra: roll daemonset to bump nf_conntrack_max + timeouts (Sam/Jenna)
- network: scale nat pool by 2x (Sam)
- app: implement connection pooling for model-cache (app team, Priya to own)
- platform: evaluate eBPF SNAT prototype (Marco)
I'll open a ticket with timelines.
Jenna: noted. I'll prep the daemonset today.
Marco: will start eBPF research doc.
Sam: scaling NAT now; ETA 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Priya: thanks everyone, keep updates here. :thumbsup:
